newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 5.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:
* Relief teams say North Korea faces a vast drought emergency.
* Some producers of so-called greenhouse gases like carbon-dioxide now support curbing those gases.
* A federal advisory panel has recommended abolishing the Immigration and Naturalization Service.
* The budget bill awaiting President Clinton's signature includes two health insurance options that represent a radical departure from current Medicare policy.
* The New York state legislature pased legislation that would create a special public school district for a small but influential community of Hasidic Jews in Orange County.
*Resurgent labor is taking on the 'new' competitive economy in fight over part-time workers at UPS.
